diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~26% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.244), which favours a robust combination.

test a trimmed_mean on the full pool to see if trimming the extremes improves robustness given high correlation.
test weighted on the full pool with inverse_error weights to see if expanding the pool improves robustness given high correlation.
test a pooled_meta_model weight (w1) on the full pool to see if a meta‑model can improve robustness given high correlation and unstable ranking.
test a weighted combination on the smaller, high‑performing pool1 (ETS, THETA, rf, catboost, FT_catboost) using inverse_error to see if reducing correlated errors improves SMAPE.
Testing a simple median on the smaller stable pool1 to see if reducing model diversity improves robustness given high correlation.
test a simple mean on the full pool to see if averaging all models improves robustness given high correlation and unstable ranking.
The series has strong trend/seasonality and unstable ranking; try a weighted combination on a larger but still selective pool (pool2) with inverse_error to see if adding FT_rf improves robustness.
test a weighted combination on pool3 (ARIMA, ETS, THETA, rf, catboost, FT_rf) to see if adding FT_rf improves performance over pool1.
Test a DBA approach on the stable pool1 to see if iterative refinement improves robustness given high correlation and unstable ranking.
test trimmed_mean on the smaller stable pool1 (trend strong, but ranking unstable) to see if trimming reduces correlated error impact.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8535. Series context: trend strength 0.9999 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.244); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.026.
